hypothesis: A deterministic pseudo-random score, seeded on (ISIN, as-of date) and carrying no information about any company, has no cross-sectional predictive content for forward returns in the smallcap-inclusive Indian equity universe. This study is a calibration control for the evaluation harness itself, not an investment hypothesis: its purpose is to confirm that the harness returns NOT SIGNIFICANT on a factor that is empty by construction.

factor.name: seeded_noise
factor.definition: SHA-256 of the string '<seed>|<as_of_date>|<isin>', with the leading 8 bytes read as a big-endian unsigned integer and divided by 2^64 to give a value in [0, 1). Deterministic across runs, independent across names and dates.
factor.rationale_for_inclusion: Control. If this factor is ever reported as significant after multiple-testing correction, the harness is miscalibrated and every other result it has produced is suspect.

null_structure: The null is that the true cross-sectional rank correlation between the factor score and the forward 63-session return is zero at every rebalance date, and that the top-quantile portfolio's net-of-cost excess return over NIFTY_500_TRI has zero mean. Under the null, the observed mean IC is distributed around zero with a standard error inflated by the cross-sectional correlation structure of the universe, which is why the reported t-statistic uses effective N rather than raw N and an autocorrelation-adjusted standard error rather than the naive one.

primary_metric.name: mean_net_long_only_excess_return
primary_metric.description: Mean net-of-cost return of the top quintile minus the benchmark total return over the same horizon.
primary_metric.significance_requirement: Must survive Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control at q=0.10 across every trial in the persistent registry AND achieve a deflated Sharpe ratio of at least 0.95.

kill_conditions: Mean rank IC is negative over the full window.
Result is NOT SIGNIFICANT after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the full trial registry.
Mean top-quantile turnover exceeds 90% per rebalance, which would make any gross signal uncapturable net of cost.
Fewer than 12 usable rebalance periods in the window.

interpretation_asymmetry.null_result_rules_out: That this specific seeded-noise construction, on this universe tier, at this horizon, with this preprocessing, carries exploitable cross-sectional signal. For a control factor this is the expected and desired outcome: it demonstrates the harness does not manufacture significance from a factor that is empty by construction.
interpretation_asymmetry.null_result_does_not_rule_out: Anything about any real factor. A null here says the measuring instrument reads zero on a blank sample; it says nothing about what the instrument would read on a real one. It also does not establish that the harness has power to detect a true effect — that is a separate question requiring a factor with known signal.
interpretation_asymmetry.positive_result_does_not_establish: Nothing whatsoever. A positive result on this study is not a discovery; it is evidence that the harness is broken. The correct response is to stop running studies and debug the evaluation code, not to investigate the factor.

notes: Registered as part of §17 CP8. This is the only study in this repo whose desired outcome is a null, and the only one where a positive result should be read as a bug report rather than a finding.
